title: VALUEFLOW: Toward Pluralistic and Steerable Value-based Alignment in Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper introduces a framework to align and evaluate LLMs based on pluralistic human values, explicitly utilizing moral and ethical theories such as Schwartz's Theory of Basic Values, Moral Foundations Theory, and Ross's Prima Facie Duties. It also includes a specific application of the framework to a religious ethical tradition, Buddhist ethics, testing model steering on concepts like karma, mindfulness, and non-attachment.
